exact_N_admitted_order.reason: Full raw target/frame payloads are absent, so dense selection, frame_prefix, pose_row_check, and full-row reserve checks cannot be replayed.

filters.execution: Exact AST function bodies for routing helpers and prepare_exclusions; unchanged s1_exclusions module. No GPU imports.
filters.rule: Copied, seal-verified s1_exclusions.Exclusions.expect/keep/report on original projected dataset/scene; no invented canonical row fields.

fixture_join.scope: Foreign capacity fixture; different pose receipt and source database hashes; cannot prove N production membership.

limitations: Scene-only survivors are an upper bound, never an admitted population.
The mandatory BENCH rejection is proved for each target; its first actual rejection in an N run is MISSING.
Raw database hashes are receipt/attestation pins; local gzip projection bytes are independently hashed.
This pose-family proof does not close the entire data_rows_r2 record.

missing.kind: N production preparation receipt and admitted pose order
missing.note: No N-bound order recovered in searched build inventory; output path is inherited and must be authenticated against N config.

room_rule.ARKit_limit: s1_exclusions does not infer an unlisted ARKit capture-to-venue mapping; these two captures have explicit BENCH tokens and independently verified venue membership.
room_rule.full_room_authority: r1_rooms.Rooms.admit is called by r1_routing.compose, not by the pose preparation loop; its audit covers routing slices/VQA, not all raw pose.
room_rule.r0: carrier_c1_run.excluded_row invokes r0_exclusion.reserve for pose and Rows.row rechecks it for r1_training.
room_rule.scene_rule: BENCH physical_groups and rung1_tokens are loaded; supplied canonical/physical_group/room/alias fields are matched; ScanNet room prefix is inferred.
room_rule.venue_exception: r2_policy.record new_training requires PROVEN_CLEAN and exclusions_complete; no lineage venue exception applies.
